# Adapter label without a fragment

The framing is glossed at [the glossary entry for §15.4.1](../glossary.html),
a link whose destination carries no fragment and whose label names the
retiring subsection.

The protocol itself is stated in
[the adapter protocol, whose label wraps across a line while it names
§15.4.1](../../spec/28_communication-channels.md#2851-ch-adapterbinary),
whose target the pass redirects while its label stands.

The envelope the carve-out keeps in place is cited as §15.4 in prose, which
is the first occurrence the sense register answers for.
